products.name: Scope Change Ledger
products.product: A client-visible record that turns out-of-scope requests into explicit impact and approval decisions.
products.audience: small creative, design, and digital agencies
products.problem: Extra requests are accepted in calls and chat without a clear record of their effect on deliverables, time, fees, or deadlines.
products.valueProposition: Creates a lightweight path from request to impact estimate, client decision, updated plan, and invoice evidence.
products.topic: agency scope change and change request tracking
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets scope creep tracker, agency change request template, out-of-scope email, and project change log searches.

products.name: Client Asset Chaser
products.product: A structured request-and-reminder workflow for collecting copy, credentials, files, approvals, and other client inputs.
products.audience: small creative, design, and digital agencies
products.problem: Teams repeatedly ask for missing client inputs without a shared definition of what is complete, which blocks delivery while making the agency look late.
products.valueProposition: Gives each input an owner, acceptance criteria, due date, dependency, reminder path, and received status.
products.topic: client asset collection and missing content tracking for agencies
products.monetization: $19-$79/month based on active records or team size
products.startupCost: Static product probe, managed database, email integration, and lightweight scheduled jobs.
products.seoAngle: Targets client asset request template, website content collection checklist, client onboarding documents, and missing assets reminder searches.
